definitions.sunlight_fraction: count(sun_elevation_deg > 0) / 336; center of Sun above smooth geometric tangent horizon at hourly samples
definitions.earth_visibility_fraction: count(earth_elevation_deg > 0) / 336; center of Earth above smooth geometric tangent horizon at hourly samples
definitions.simultaneous_state_change: adjacent hourly samples switch the Boolean simultaneous state; transition timestamp is the first sample in the new state, so crossing is bracketed by the preceding hour
definitions.disagreement: Sun and Earth center-elevation Boolean states differ

data_quality.interpretation: No missing samples, duplicate keys, non-finite/out-of-range geometry, or unexpected angular discontinuity detected.

recommended_demo_comparison.selection_rule: Largest pairwise difference in simultaneous_availability_fraction among the nine evaluated within-window site pairs. This is a post hoc descriptive ranking over the fixed comparison set, not a statistical significance test or an exhaustive search over epochs.

limitations: Visibility is operationally defined here only as center elevation >0° above a smooth geometric tangent horizon; it is not apparent-disk or terrain-aware visibility.
Coordinates are provisionally interpreted in MOON_ME_DE421; the cited source does not explicitly state the coordinate frame.
Only three preselected windows and three point sites are included; ranking is descriptive and not a mission-optimized or exhaustive site evaluation.
Hourly sampling brackets transitions to one-hour intervals and may miss shorter changes; reported fractions are sample-count fractions, not continuous-duration integrals.
No uncertainty model, terrain, power, communications, environment, or surface engineering model is included.
recommendation_status: Compelling for a bounded geometric comparison demonstration; not sufficient to claim validated absolute site ranking or true operational visibility.
